findings.evidence: Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Basic.lean:846 `def piCongrLeft := (piCongrLeft' P e.symm).symm`; Mathlib/Data/Finset/Image.lean:258 `equivMap := .ofBijective (fun x ↦ ⟨f x, _⟩) _`.
findings.fix: Prove bijectivity against the stated function explicitly, e.g. `by convert (Equiv.piCongrLeft ..).symm.bijective` followed by `funext` and `simp [Equiv.piCongrLeft_symm_apply, Finset.equivMap]`, or build the equivalence as `{ (Equiv.piCongrLeft ..).symm with map_mul' := .. }` and prove `mulEquivMap_apply` by `simp`.
findings.issue: `MulEquiv.ofBijective` is given `(Equiv.piCongrLeft _ (I.equivMap f)).symm.bijective`, which proves bijectivity of a different function. It is accepted only because `piCongrLeft.symm` unfolds to `piCongrLeft' _ e.symm` and `(I.equivMap f).symm.symm` unfolds to `fun β ↦ ⟨f β, _⟩`. This defeq crosses the `Equiv.piCongrLeft`, `Equiv.symm` and `Equiv.ofBijective` wrappers and has no comment.

findings.evidence: Lines 252-256: `simp only [regLocus_reindex, baseHomeomorph_reindex]` then `rfl`; `footprintMap_reindex` is at lines 233-242.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `footprintMap_reindex` and `coe_reindexZeroHomeomorph` instead of closing with `rfl`.
findings.issue: `footprint_reindex` ends with `simp only [...]; rfl`. The `rfl` relies on the reindexed `footprintMap` being definitionally `𝒜.footprintMap _ ∘ reindexZeroHomeomorph`, even though `footprintMap_reindex` states exactly that equation a few lines earlier.

findings.evidence: Lines 158-159, 161-162 and 168-170 contain `reindexZeroHomeomorph, Homeomorph.setCongr_apply`; lines 129-131 and 141-143 use `coe_reindexZeroHomeomorph` instead.
findings.fix: Replace `reindexZeroHomeomorph, Homeomorph.setCongr_apply` with `coe_reindexZeroHomeomorph` (plus `Subtype.ext` where needed) in all three blocks (lines ~158, ~161, ~168).
findings.issue: The `footprintMap_act`, `footprintMap_self` and `footprintMap_footprintMap` blocks close with `simpa only [F, Function.comp_apply, reindexZeroHomeomorph, Homeomorph.setCongr_apply, ...]`. They unfold the private definition and the `setCongr` internals, while the sibling fields (`kuranishi_footprintMap`, `mem_regLocus_of_footprintMap_mem`) use the stable `coe_reindexZeroHomeomorph`. These are unfolding-heavy terse proofs that break if `Homeomorph.setCongr` changes.

findings.evidence: Lines 104-201 hold ten `?_` placeholders, each discharged by an unlabeled bullet.
findings.fix: Put a short comment naming the field before each bullet (e.g. `-- kuranishi_act`, `-- footprintMap_act`), or move the longer blocks (`footprintMap_eq_footprintMap_iff`, `range_footprintMap_inter`, `exists_footprintMap_eq`) into private lemmas, as was already done for `reindex_exists_openPartialHomeomorph`.
findings.issue: The `reindex` body is about 95 lines. After the big `refine`, ten anonymous `·` bullets discharge the `?_` fields, and their order is the only link back to the field names. Apart from two local comments there is nothing explaining the structure.

summary: The proofs build their results correctly but depend on undocumented definitional equality in `mulEquivMap` and at the end of `footprint_reindex`, and several `simpa` calls in `reindex` unfold the private `reindexZeroHomeomorph` and `Homeomorph.setCongr` where the existing `coe_reindexZeroHomeomorph` lemma would do. The `reindex` body is about 95 lines of unlabeled `?_` bullets.
